independence_evidence: Site footer: '© LEAFIE LIMITED 2026 ... LEAFIE is a registered trademark of LEAFIE LIMITED'; about page describes it as 'an independent media platform exploring cannabis, psychedelics and culture'.
qualifies_reason: Independent London publisher whose print Issue 02 (published June 2025) is on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A UK print magazine about cannabis, psychedelics and the culture around them, spun out of a daily news website on the same subjects. Each issue is an A4-ish, PUR-bound volume of around 120 pages mixing long reads on drug history and policy, interviews with growers, artists and researchers, and features on the UK and European scene rather than the North American one. It suits readers interested in drug reform, medical cannabis and psychedelic research who want it in a considered print format.
